  • #2633 review comment (within().error bounds)

issue.title: [string_scanner] Fix SpanScanner.within() and LineScanner edge cases
issue.body_html:
• Fix SpanScanner.within()'s state.line and state.column to return span-relative coordinates rather than file-relative offsets.
  • Fix SpanScanner.within()'s error() to default length to 0 rather than 1 when lastMatch is null, preventing a RangeError when the span ends at the end of the underlying SourceFile.
  • Fix SpanScanner.within()'s lastSpan to be cleared when lastMatch is lazily invalidated after a position change.
  • Fix SpanScanner.within()'s spanFromPosition() to validate ranges against string.length rather than _sourceFile.length - _startLocation.offset.
  • Fix LineScanner.position= and SpanScanner.eager().position= to clear lastMatch and lastSpan when assigned the current position.
  • Deduplicate forward and backward CR/LF newline detection in _LineScanner via _isNewlineAt() and _advancePosition(), avoiding substring allocations in LineScanner.scan().
issue.body_text:
Fix SpanScanner.within()'s state.line and state.column to return span-relative coordinates rather than file-relative offsets.
Fix SpanScanner.within()'s error() to default length to 0 rather than 1 when lastMatch is null, preventing a RangeError when the span ends at the end of the underlying SourceFile.
Fix SpanScanner.within()'s lastSpan to be cleared when lastMatch is lazily invalidated after a position change.
Fix SpanScanner.within()'s spanFromPosition() to validate ranges against string.length rather than _sourceFile.length - _startLocation.offset.
Fix LineScanner.position= and SpanScanner.eager().position= to clear lastMatch and lastSpan when assigned the current position.
